properties.description: Command-line tool to bulk re-open 5927 blocked AmazonPay investigations after PPI launch. Implemented in record time. Tool generically written and re-used for another use-case. Reported as successfully delivered in weekly report.

RiskDocument designed as generic payload carrier for Fortress (fraud/abuse detection). Design approved by SDE-3, principal & samurai group. Launched first version of EvaluateRisk API for CS-Tech use-case. Supports 6 clients — RiskDocument structure unchanged since launch. Presented to TRMS director Anand (anandva@). Won TRMS Zeus Team Award Oct 2017.

RCSQueryGeneration Tool — queries RetailCatalogService, processes results, uploads to EDX warehouse. DJS jobs run daily. Backfilled 930M vendor contribution responses + 1.1B create-by-date responses (from 1970 to present). Processes ~30,000 ASINs/day continuously. Ingested 1.9B ASINs across 12 marketplaces and 2 categories.

Designed, coded and introduced self-service migration process for inconsistent XML-to-JSON ion generation. Bulk Migrator Tool + self-service wiki. 29 feed providers migrated without SDE involvement. Improved Elasticsearch catalog indexing by 20%.

Enhanced VariableComparisonTool for reporting variable mismatches between FRS (legacy) and Fortress (replacement) for SVA use-case. Generic code changes: GLS filtering, variable filtering, sample OrderIds, decimal point precision. 60% SDE effort reduction.
Migrated COD suppression rules from stage-3 to stage-1 of AbuseCOPS to ensure evaluation results computed within 250ms during flash sales. Root cause: suppression slippages during peak traffic.

Enabling Queue Management Service for IN SVA Retail. Addressed SLA adherence challenges during peak promotional traffic (Diwali, Christmas, Cyber Monday). Investigation queues had 1hr SLA with high volume.
Analyzed Profiler (profiler.amazon.com) data for AbusePreventionService. Identified high CPU consuming cycles in non-business logic code. GC time reduced from 15% to 2.42%. TPS improvement of 20%.

Two hardware optimization initiatives: (1) Dec 2017 — replaced old-generation EC2 hosts with new generation, saved $23,000/year. (2) Prime Day 2018 APS & AbuseCOPS FLO testing — right-sized fleet, saved $12,344.16/year. Total: ~$35,344/year hardware savings.
Prime Day 2018 scaling preparation for APS & AbuseCOPS. Ran FLO tests, benchmarked hosts, right-sized fleet. Saved $12,344.16/year.

One of 3 scrum facilitators in India recognized by EngineeringExcellence team. Facilitated 3 scrum workshops (~90 participants) and 1 agile product ownership workshop (~10 participants). Also one of 3 agile PO workshop facilitators recognized by EngineeringExcellence in India. Team task completion rate improved from 50% to 85% via Scaling for Development process.
68 interviews conducted in 18 months (Jan 2017 – May 2018). Created interview question bank used in 14 weekend interview events. Tech-reviewer for 3 L4→L5 promotion docs — all positive conversions.

Created 3 onboarding assets: (1) ACSCS structured onboarding with high-quality content repository — still used for all ACSCS SDE onboarding. (2) TRMS SVA specific onboarding page. (3) 1st-week non-tech guide — reduces setup from 1 week to ~2 days. Also created TRMS-INPay On-call helpbook and legendary bookmark & troubleshooting pages referenced 1000+ times.

Led SVA OneAccountOneCustomer fraud use-case end-to-end: requirements gathering, design, stakeholder comms, coding 1 & 2, onboarding. Family & friends launch March 2017, GA July 2017. Appreciated by directors of TRMS. Resolved launch blocker TT-0128828360 (payment instrument type wrongly sent).

Fortress platform for fraud/abuse detection across Amazon India. RiskDocument as generic payload carrier for multiple clients. EvaluateRisk API supporting 6 clients. FRS-to-Fortress migration validation via VariableComparisonTool.
